# Fixture provenance

Synthetic fixtures generated by prepare_testdata.py; no patient data. Licensed Apache-2.0 with this repository.

`input.dcm` is a 6 x 6 mm superficial slab (300 x 300, 0.02 mm) of seeded capillary-like texture with a dark circular foveal avascular zone of radius 0.3 mm (area 0.2827 mm2) at the scan centre, so the measures have known answers. `input-disc.dcm`, `input-unidentified.dcm` and `input-unknown.dcm` are authored cases the encoder must degrade on. The frozen responses in expected.json are a regression baseline, not a clinical ground truth.
